A very good service, everyone is very friendly and hospitable! The room is cleaned every day and the bedding is changed every three days. Every room is supplied with a variety of fruits and desserts, the portioned coffee and tea are refreshed daily, bottled water, necessities, and tableware. Freshly washed towels every day and incense is renewed. The dishes at the restaurant are very tasty, true, they are more expensive than in the city, but the portions of these dishes are very huge, so the price is justified.
